pageTitle: Duet Mail for Horseback Rides & Trail Guides | AI Email Assistant
metaDescription: Duet Mail helps trail ride operators respond to booking emails instantly — even from the saddle. AI-drafted replies with your pricing, rider requirements, and voice.

verticalFaqs.question: How does Duet handle sensitive questions about weight or experience requirements?
verticalFaqs.answer: Duet learns your specific policies and mirrors your tone. When someone asks about weight limits or experience requirements, it responds professionally and warmly — sharing the information they need without making it awkward. You set the tone once and Duet follows it consistently, so every guest feels respected.

verticalFaqs.question: Can Duet handle group bookings with different rider needs?
verticalFaqs.answer: Yes. Duet learns your ride types, group sizes, age minimums, and any rider-specific requirements. When a family or group emails about booking, it drafts a reply that covers pricing for the full group, what each rider needs to know, and available time slots. You review and send — no back-and-forth needed.
